_note: Fable, F7. Smudge narrates; rivals and heroes may speak for themselves. {you} is a hero's short name, {n} a number, {call} the stat, {calls} the round's three, {rival} the opponent.
level_text: Plays whatever it draws and hopes.
Saves cards for the right turn and walks away from rounds it cannot win.
round_start: Round {n}. Smudge will be asking for {calls}, in that order.
Round {n}: {calls}. Worth a think before the first card.
{calls}. That is round {n}. Smudge has sharpened the quill.
you_round: Yours. Smudge stamps it before anyone argues.
That round goes in your column.
Round to you. {rival} is pretending not to mind.
them_round: {rival} takes that one. Smudge writes it very small.
That round went the other way.
Round to {rival}. There are more rounds.
big: {you} put up {n}. Somebody had a good breakfast.
{n}. {you} would like that noted, and it is.
sapped: Something happened to {you} on the way to the table.
{you} came out of that smaller than they went in.
pass: A quiet turn. Smudge approves of patience, in others.
win: Yours. Smudge closes the ledger on it.
Won. {rival} is asking for a recount and not getting one.
That is the duel. Smudge has already inked it.
lose: That one goes to {rival}. Smudge has seen worse.
{rival} takes it. The deck is already reshuffled.
paid: +{n} gold. The first {max} repeat wins of the day pay.
unpaid: The purse is empty until tomorrow. That one was for the love of it.
cant_energy: {you} costs more energy than you have left.
cant_three: Three cards a turn. Smudge only has so much table.
cant_lock: {you} is locked this turn. Someone on the other side did that.
stand_you: You sat this round out. {rival} can have it; the energy is yours.
stand_them: {rival} has folded the round. Spend to be safe, or save it.
captain_you: {you} steps forward. Play them this turn or the call is wasted.
captain_them: {rival} is calling on {you}. Expect a large number.
sum_idle: Tap a card to play it. Smudge is counting {call}.
sum_down: Sitting this round out. {n} extra energy next round.
swap_text: Anything you put back goes under your deck and comes round again.
lesson: This is your energy. Seven more arrives every turn, and what you do not spend keeps.
Each turn Smudge counts one thing. A fast card is worth nothing when he is counting Health.
Tap a card to play it. Top right is what it scores this turn. Top left is what it costs.
Now press Ready. Both sides turn their cards over together.
Smudge carries the difference on his board and stands nearer whoever is behind. Three turns a round, three rounds to win.

rival_win.tiber: Something in the river laughs. It goes on for a while.
rival_win.tony: “No hard feelings. We will be keeping the table.”
rival_win.brenda: “I will be putting this in the minutes.”
rival_win.vanguard: They did not even break formation.
rival_win.gary: He circles the table once, slowly, to make the point.
rival_win.nephew: “Uncle will hear of this. He will be so pleased.”
rival_win.well: The well makes a satisfied sound.
rival_win.antlers: The ice creaks. It sounds like an opinion.

rival_lose.tiber: A long bubble rises from the Tiber and pops, sourly.
rival_lose.tony: “The boys would like a rematch. The boys insist.”
rival_lose.brenda: “Fine. But somebody is restocking the staples.”
rival_lose.vanguard: They retreat in good order and will deny it.
rival_lose.gary: Gary leaves between the flags, which he never does.
rival_lose.nephew: “I let you win. Ask anyone. Do not ask anyone.”
rival_lose.well: Something goes back down, slowly, muttering.
rival_lose.antlers: The antlers sink out of sight. The ice says nothing.
